habitats[] is reconstructed from Appendix B. All 11 tables (Coastal, Desert, Any, Arctic, Grassland, Forest, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark, Underwater, Urban) are now complete, confirmed against the physical book on 2026-10-11. Outsiders, fiends, undead, and constructs legitimately have no habitat per the book's own design.
Black Bear, Blood Hawk, and Giant Venomous Snake were added on 2026-10-11 from the user's own reading of the physical book (they were absent from the original OCR extraction).

A round of corrections (ability scores, HP dice, action text, CR/XP swaps, habitat tables) from the user's read of the physical book was applied on 2026-10-11 to every entry the original OCR transcription had flagged as uncertain. Spirit Naga's creature type (Large Fiend) was confirmed correct by the user on 2026-10-11.

Dracolich: the 2024 Monster Manual has no standalone stat block for it (it's a template applied to a dragon of the DM's choice). At the user's request on 2026-10-11, a homebrew Dracolich entry was added below, adapted from the Adult Black Dragon stat block (Part 2, p.39) with a necrotic theme. It is flagged in its own 'source' field as homebrew, not official content.

ocr_flag '🚨' on a record marks an entry whose header itself was marked uncertain during the original OCR pass; most field-level ambiguities surfaced separately and were resolved in the 2026-10-11 correction pass above.

2026-10-18 cleanup (Claude, artifact v228-v234): gear text moved out of Immunities/Resistances into weapons/armor/gear (13 creatures); Legendary Actions moved into their own field for 9 creatures whose text sat inside actions/reactions; homebrew Dracolich given Legendary Actions; CR corrected for Vrock, Giant Squid, Cyclops Sentry (5->6) and Gulthias Blight (15->16), XP unchanged; Bonus Actions/Reactions blocks embedded in actions moved to their own fields and '**Spellcasting.**' headers reformatted as '- *Spellcasting.*' action entries (79 creatures, wording unchanged); the 61 'Medium or Small …' style records now carry size in 'size' (e.g. 'Medium or Small') and subtype in 'subtype' instead of folding both into 'type'.

monsters.name: Needle Blight
monsters.actions:
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4+1) Slashing.
- *Needles.* Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 30/60 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4+1) Piercing.

monsters.name: Panther
monsters.actions: - *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Nimble Escape.* The panther takes the Disengage or Hide action.

monsters.name: Pixie
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The pixie has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Faerie Dust.* Melee or Ranged Attack: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 1 Radiant damage, and the target has the Charmed or Poisoned condition (pixie's choice) until the start of the pixie's next turn.
- *Spellcasting.* The pixie casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12): At Will: Dancing Lights, Druidcraft, Invisibility (self only). 1/Day Each: Detect Thoughts, Fly, Sleep.

monsters.name: Priest Acolyte
monsters.actions:
- *Mace.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Radiant damage.
- *Radiant Flame.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.
- *Spellcasting.* The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability: At Will: Light, Thaumaturgy.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Divine Aid (1/Day).* The priest casts Bless, Healing Word, or Sanctuary, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Pseudodragon
monsters.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 15
monsters.languages: Understands Common and Draconic but can't speak
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The pseudodragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The pseudodragon makes two Bite attacks.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.
- *Sting.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pseudodragon can see within 5 feet. Failure: 5 (2d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or More: The Poisoned target also has the Unconscious condition until it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it awake.

monsters.name: Pteranodon
monsters.traits: - *Flyby.* The pteranodon doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Riding Horse
monsters.actions: - *Hooves.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Skeleton
monsters.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak
monsters.actions:
- *Shortsword.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
- *Shortbow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Smoke Mephit
monsters.traits: - *Death Burst.* The mephit explodes when it dies. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
monsters.actions:
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.
- *Cinder Breath (Recharge 6).* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the mephit can see within 15 feet. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mephit's next turn.

monsters.name: Sprite
monsters.actions:
- *Needle Sword.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.
- *Enchanting Bow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.
- *Heart Sight.* Charisma Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). Failure: The sprite knows the target's emotions and alignment.
- *Invisibility.* The sprite casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

monsters.name: Steam Mephit
monsters.traits:
- *Blurred Form.* Attack rolls against the mephit are made with Disadvantage unless the mephit has the Incapacitated condition.
- *Death Burst.* The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
monsters.actions:
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage.
- *Steam Breath (Recharge 6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit's next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

monsters.name: Swarm of Bats
monsters.immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
monsters.traits: - *Swarm.* The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
monsters.actions: - *Bites.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (2d4) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

monsters.name: Swarm of Rats
monsters.immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
monsters.traits: - *Swarm.* The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny rat. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
monsters.actions: - *Bites.* Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (2d4) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

monsters.name: Swarm of Ravens
monsters.immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
monsters.traits: - *Swarm.* The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny raven. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
monsters.actions:
- *Beaks.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.
- *Cacophony (Recharge 6).* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature in the swarm's space. Failure: The target has the Deafened condition until the start of the swarm's next turn. While Deafened, the target also has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

monsters.name: Troglodyte
monsters.traits:
- *Stench.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, any creature (other than a troglodyte) that starts its turn in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the troglodyte. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to the Stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.
- *Sunlight Sensitivity.* While in sunlight, the troglodyte has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
monsters.actions: - *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

monsters.name: Violet Fungus
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), Passive Perception 7
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The fungus makes two Rotting Touch attacks.
- *Rotting Touch.* Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 10 ft. Hit: 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Winged Kobold
monsters.traits:
- *Pack Tactics.* As the kobold warrior's trait, above.
- *Sunlight Sensitivity.* As the kobold warrior's trait, above.
monsters.actions:
- *Dragon-Tooth Blade.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
- *Chromatic Spittle.* Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) damage of a type chosen by the kobold: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.

monsters.name: Wolf
monsters.traits: - *Pack Tactics.* The wolf has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Zombie
monsters.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak
monsters.traits: - *Undead Fortitude.* If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.
monsters.actions: - *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Ape
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The ape makes two Fist attacks.
- *Fist.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Rock (Recharge 6).* Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 25/50 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Black Bear
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The bear makes two Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.
monsters.source: Monster Manual (2024), Animals appendix (added from physical book, 2026-10-11)

monsters.name: Crocodile
monsters.traits: - *Hold Breath.* The crocodile can hold its breath for 1 hour.
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

monsters.name: Dust Mephit
monsters.traits: - *Death Burst.* The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.
monsters.actions:
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.
- *Blinding Breath (Recharge 6).* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mephit's next turn.
- *Sleep (1/Day).* The mephit casts the *Sleep* spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10).

monsters.name: Gas Spore Fungus
monsters.immunities: Poison; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Poisoned
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), Passive Perception 7
monsters.traits: - *False Appearance.* While the gas spore remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a beholder.
monsters.actions: - *Death Burst.* The gas spore explodes when it drops to 0 HP. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature within 10 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Poison damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is pushed 10 feet away. Success: Half damage, no push. The spore also releases spores on anyone within 10 feet; failure results in a spore implanting that erupts into a new gas spore in 1d4 days if not removed.

monsters.name: Giant Goat
monsters.actions: - *Ram.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the goat moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Giant Seahorse
monsters.traits: - *Water Breathing.* The seahorse can breathe only underwater.
monsters.actions: - *Ram.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage if the seahorse moved 20+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Bubble Dash.* While underwater, the seahorse moves up to half its Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
monsters.ocr_note: Giant Seahorse's ability-score line was heavily garbled in OCR (showed Str 23/Dex 11/Con 21), which does not reconcile with the printed AC 14/HP 16 (3d10) — standard 2024 MM values (Str 12, Dex 11, Con 12) are used here instead, consistent with the attack bonus (+3 with Str +1 and PB +2).

monsters.name: Gnoll Warrior
monsters.actions:
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
- *Bone Bow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Rampage (1/Day).* Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

monsters.name: Gray Ooze
monsters.immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained
monsters.traits:
- *Amorphous.* The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
- *Corrosive Form.* Nonmagical ammunition is destroyed immediately after hitting the ooze and dealing any damage. Any nonmagical weapon takes a cumulative −1 penalty to attack rolls immediately after dealing damage to the ooze and coming into contact with it. The weapon is destroyed if the penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting *Mending* on the weapon. The ooze can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal or wood in 1 round.
monsters.actions: - *Pseudopod.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10. The penalty can be removed by casting *Mending* on the armor.

monsters.name: Hobgoblin Warrior
monsters.traits: - *Pack Tactics.* The hobgoblin has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hobgoblin's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
monsters.actions: - *Longsword.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d10 + 1) Slashing damage.

monsters.name: Ice Mephit
monsters.traits: - *Death Burst.* The mephit explodes when it dies. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
monsters.actions:
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.
- *Fog Cloud (1/Day).* The mephit casts *Fog Cloud*, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
- *Cold Breath (Recharge 6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Jackalwere
monsters.traits: - *Pack Tactics.* The jackalwere has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the jackalwere's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The jackalwere makes two Rend or Slam attacks.
- *Rend (Jackal or Hybrid Form Only).* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
- *Slam (Human or Hybrid Form Only).* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Sleep Gaze (Recharge 5–6).* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature the jackalwere can see within 30 feet (Constructs and Undead succeed automatically). Failure: The target has the Unconscious condition for 10 minutes or until it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. Success: The target is immune to this jackalwere's Sleep Gaze for 24 hours.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shape-Shift.* The jackalwere shape-shifts into a Medium human or a Medium jackal-humanoid hybrid, or it returns to its true form (that of a Small jackal). Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monsters.name: Magma Mephit
monsters.traits: - *Death Burst.* The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
monsters.actions:
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
- *Fire Breath (Recharge 6).* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Magmin
monsters.traits: - *Death Burst.* The magmin explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the magmin. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
monsters.actions: - *Touch.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Ignited Illumination.* The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

monsters.name: Modron Tridrone
monsters.traits: - *Disintegration.* As above.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The modron makes three Clockwork Spear attacks.
- *Clockwork Spear.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Force damage. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the modron's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

monsters.name: Myconid Adult
monsters.traits: - *Sun Sickness.* As the sprout's trait, above.
monsters.actions:
- *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
- *Pacifying Spores (1/Day).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the myconid can see within 10 feet. Failure: The target has the Stunned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
- *Rapport Spores.* As the sprout's trait, above.

monsters.name: Performer
monsters.actions: - *Shortsword.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
monsters.reactions: - *Uncanny Dodge.* Trigger: The performer is hit by an attack roll. Response: The performer halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.

monsters.name: Piercer
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 8
monsters.traits: - *Spider Climb.* The piercer can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
monsters.actions:
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.
- *Drop.* The piercer falls. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature directly underneath the piercer. Failure: 10 (3d6) Piercing damage. Failure or Success: The piercer reduces any damage it takes from the fall by 20.

monsters.name: Reef Shark
monsters.traits:
- *Pack Tactics.* The shark has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the shark's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
- *Water Breathing.* The shark can breathe only underwater.
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Rust Monster
monsters.traits: - *Iron Scent.* The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.
- *Antennae.* The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object — armor or a weapon — worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, the creature with the object. Failure: The object takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor or weapon.
- *Destroy Metal.* The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn't being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot Cube of the object.
monsters.reactions: - *Reflexive Antennae.* Trigger: An attack roll hits the rust monster. Response: The rust monster uses Antennae.

monsters.name: Sahuagin Warrior
monsters.traits:
- *Blood Frenzy.* The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.
- *Limited Amphibiousness.* The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.
- *Shark Telepathy.* The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The sahuagin makes two Claw attacks.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Aquatic Charge.* The sahuagin swims up to its Swim Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.

monsters.name: Satyr
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The satyr has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Hooves.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the satyr pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.
- *Mockery.* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the satyr can see within 90 feet. Failure: 5 (1d6 + 2) Psychic damage.

monsters.name: Scout
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.
- *Shortsword.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
- *Longbow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Shadow
monsters.immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
monsters.traits:
- *Amorphous.* The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
- *Sunlight Weakness.* While in sunlight, the shadow has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.
monsters.actions: - *Draining Swipe.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score decreases by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. If a Humanoid is slain by this attack, a Shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shadow Stealth.* While in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadow takes the Hide action.

monsters.name: Swarm of Insects
monsters.speed: 20 ft, Climb or Fly 20 ft (DM's choice)
monsters.immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
monsters.traits:
- *Spider Climb.* If the swarm has a Climb Speed, the swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
- *Swarm.* The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
monsters.actions: - *Bites.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Poison damage, or 3 (1d4 + 1) Poison damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

monsters.name: Tough
monsters.traits: - *Pack Tactics.* The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
monsters.actions:
- *Mace.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Heavy Crossbow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Troll Limb
monsters.traits:
- *Regeneration.* The limb regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the limb takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the limb's next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.
- *Troll Spawn.* The limb uncannily has the same senses as a whole troll. If the limb isn't destroyed within 24 hours, roll 1d12. On a 12, the limb turns into a Troll. Otherwise, the limb withers away.
monsters.actions: - *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

monsters.name: Vine Blight
monsters.actions:
- *Constricting Vine.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) Bludgeoning; Large-or-smaller target Grappled (escape DC 12); while grappled, target takes 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning at start of each turn and the blight can't attack with this.
- *Entangling Plants (Recharge 5–6).* Casts Entangle, Con spell save DC 12.

monsters.name: Warhorse
monsters.actions: - *Hooves.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the horse moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Warhorse Skeleton
monsters.actions: - *Hooves.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Worg
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the start of the worg's next turn has Advantage.

monsters.name: Animated Armor
monsters.immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Slam attacks.
- *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) Bludgeoning.

monsters.name: Brass Dragon Wyrmling
monsters.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 14
monsters.actions:
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) Slashing.
- *Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 11, each creature in a 20-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire. Success: half.
- *Sleep Breath.* Con Save DC 11, each creature in a 15-ft Cone. Failure: Incapacitated until end of next turn, then repeats save. Second Failure: Unconscious 1 min (ends if damaged or woken).

monsters.name: Brown Bear
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The bear makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Bugbear Warrior
monsters.actions:
- *Grab.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) Bludgeoning; Medium-or-smaller target Grappled (escape DC 12).
- *Light Hammer.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4 (Advantage if target Grappled by it), reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 9 (3d4+2) Bludgeoning.

monsters.name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling
monsters.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 14
monsters.actions:
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) Slashing.
- *Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 11, 20-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 18 (4d8) Acid. Success: half.
- *Slowing Breath.* Con Save DC 11, 15-ft Cone. Failure: no Reactions, Speed halved, only action or bonus action (not both) until end of its next turn.

monsters.name: Death Dog
monsters.immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, Unconscious
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Bite attacks.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) Piercing. If target is a creature: Con Save DC 12. First Failure: Poisoned — HP max doesn't restore on Long Rest while Poisoned, repeats save every 24 hrs (success ends). Subsequent Failures: Poisoned target's HP max decreases by 5 (1d10).

monsters.name: Dire Wolf
monsters.traits: - *Pack Tactics.* The dire wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dire wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Dryad
monsters.traits:
- *Magic Resistance.* The dryad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- *Speak with Beasts and Plants.* The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.
- *Tree Stride.* Once per turn, the dryad can teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space she can see if both the space she's leaving and the one she's entering are within 5 feet of a tree of Large size or bigger.
monsters.actions:
- *Club.* Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Fey Charm.* The dryad targets one Humanoid or Beast she can see within 30 feet; Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition for 24 hours, or until the dryad dies, takes damage, or uses this trait again.

- *Spellcasting.* The dryad can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability: At will: *Druidcraft*. 3/Day each: *Entangle, Pass Without Trace*. 1/Day: *Shillelagh*.

monsters.name: Empyrean Iota
monsters.resistances: Radiant or Necrotic (choose one, matching alignment)
monsters.traits:
- *Divine Awareness.* The empyrean knows if it hears a lie.
- *Magic Resistance.* The empyrean has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The empyrean makes two Radiant (or Necrotic) Fist attacks.
- *Radiant/Necrotic Fist.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Force damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant or Necrotic damage.

- *Spellcasting.* The empyrean can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At will: *Detect Evil and Good* (or *Detect Magic*). 1/Day each: *Commune, Dispel Evil and Good* (or *Dispel Good and Evil*).

monsters.name: Faerie Dragon (Youth)
monsters.traits:
- *Euphoric Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Euphoric condition (treated as Poisoned, unable to take Bonus Actions, Advantage on saves vs. fear) for 1 minute.
- *Magic Resistance.* The dragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- *Superior Invisibility (Bonus Action).* The dragon can magically turn invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Breath, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).
monsters.actions:
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage.

- *Spellcasting.* The dragon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability: At will: *Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion*.

monsters.name: Ghoul
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The ghoul makes two Claw attacks.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Giant Eagle
monsters.languages: Celestial; understands Common and Primordial (Auran) but can't speak them
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The eagle makes two Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Radiant damage.

monsters.name: Giant Hyena
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Rampage (1/Day).* Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that was already Bloodied, the hyena can move up to half its Speed, and it makes one Bite attack.

monsters.name: Giant Octopus
monsters.traits: - *Water Breathing.* The octopus can breathe only underwater. It can hold its breath for 1 hour outside water.
monsters.actions: - *Tentacles.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from all eight tentacles. While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
monsters.reactions: - *Ink Cloud (1/Day).* Trigger: The octopus takes damage while underwater. Response: The octopus releases ink that fills a 10-foot Cube centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.

monsters.name: Giant Spider
monsters.traits:
- *Spider Climb.* The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
- *Web Walker.* The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and it knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
monsters.actions:
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
- *Web (Recharge 5–6).* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the spider can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage).

monsters.name: Giant Toad
monsters.traits:
- *Amphibious.* The toad can breathe air and water.
- *Standing Leap.* The toad's Long Jump is up to 20 feet and its High Jump is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.
monsters.actions:
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).
- *Swallow.* The toad swallows a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn't Grappled but has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad. In addition, the target takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the end of each of the toad's turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time, and it can't use Bite while it has a swallowed target. If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Giant Vulture
monsters.traits: - *Pack Tactics.* The vulture has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
monsters.actions: - *Gouge.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

monsters.name: Goblin Boss
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The goblin makes two attacks, using Scimitar or Shortbow in any combination.
- *Scimitar.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
- *Shortbow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Nimble Escape.* The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.
monsters.reactions: - *Redirect Attack.* Trigger: A creature the goblin can see makes an attack roll against it. Response: The goblin chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of itself. The goblin and that ally swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

monsters.name: Harpy
monsters.actions:
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage.
- *Luring Song.* The harpy sings a magical melody, which lasts until the harpy's Concentration ends on it. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, each Humanoid and Giant in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the harpy when the song starts. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the song ends and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and ignores the Luring Song of other harpies. If the target is more than 5 feet from the harpy, the target moves on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the harpy. It doesn't avoid Opportunity Attacks; however, before moving into damaging terrain (such as lava or a pit) and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, the target repeats the save. Success: The target is immune to this harpy's Luring Song for 24 hours.

monsters.name: Hippogriff
monsters.traits: - *Flyby.* The hippogriff doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The hippogriff makes two Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

monsters.name: Imp
monsters.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness), Passive Perception 11
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The imp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Sting.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
- *Invisibility.* The imp casts *Invisibility* on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
- *Shape-Shift.* The imp shape-shifts to resemble a rat (Speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., Fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., Climb 20 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monsters.name: Kuo-toa Monitor
monsters.senses: Darkvision 120 ft., Truesight 30 ft., Passive Perception 16
monsters.traits:
- *Amphibious.* The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.
- *Sunlight Sensitivity.* As above.
monsters.actions:
- *Pincer Staff.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the kuo-toa can't make Pincer Staff attacks.
- *Conjure Slimy Glob.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (3d4 + 2) Acid damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shield of Faith (2/Day).* The kuo-toa casts *Shield of Faith*, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

monsters.name: Lacedon (Ghoul)
monsters.traits: - *Amphibious.* The lacedon can breathe air and water.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The lacedon makes two Claw attacks.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.
- *Icy Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Cold damage.

monsters.name: Lion
monsters.traits:
- *Pack Tactics.* The lion has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
- *Running Leap.* With a 10-foot running start, the lion can Long Jump up to 25 feet.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The lion makes two Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Roar.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.
- *Roar.* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature within 15 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of the lion's next turn.

monsters.name: Manes Vaporspawn
monsters.immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned, Restrained
monsters.traits:
- *Contortionist.* The vaporspawn can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
- *Sickening Vapors.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the vaporspawn at the end of its turn. Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this vaporspawn's Sickening Vapors for 24 hours.
monsters.actions: - *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shadow Stealth.* While in Dim Light or Darkness, the vaporspawn takes the Hide action.

monsters.name: Modron Quadrone
monsters.traits: - *Disintegration.* As above.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The modron makes four Slam attacks or four Gears Launcher attacks.
- *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Force damage.
- *Gears Launcher.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 320 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Force damage.

monsters.name: Myconid Spore Servant
monsters.immunities: Poisoned; Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned
monsters.actions: - *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

monsters.name: Ogrillon Ogre
monsters.actions:
- *Battleaxe.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.
- *Javelin.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Pirate
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The pirate makes two Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Enthralling Panache.
- *Dagger.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.
- *Enthralling Panache.* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.
monsters.ocr_note: Dex save shown matching Initiative (+5), implying proficient Dex save (mod +3 + PB +2); ability scores reconstructed from these constraints and cross-checked against AC14 (Leather 11 + Dex 3) and attack bonus — consistent.

monsters.name: Psychic Gray Ooze
monsters.immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained
monsters.traits: - *Amorphous.* As the gray ooze's trait, above.
monsters.actions:
- *Pseudopod.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (3d6 + 1) Acid damage, and the target has Disadvantage on Intelligence saving throws until the end of the ooze's next turn.
- *Psychic Crush.* Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature the ooze can see within 60 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.
monsters.reactions: - *Mind Corrosion.* Trigger: The ooze fails a saving throw against a spell or another magical effect created by a creature. Response: The triggering creature takes 3 (1d6) Psychic damage.

monsters.name: Quasit
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The quasit has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the quasit's next turn.
- *Invisibility.* The quasit casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
- *Scare (1/Day).* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 20 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
- *Shape-Shift.* The quasit shape-shifts to resemble a bat (Speed 10 ft., Fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., Climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., Swim 40 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monsters.name: Salamander Fire Snake
monsters.traits: - *Fire Aura.* At the end of each of the salamander's turns, each creature of the salamander's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the salamander takes 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

monsters.name: Scarecrow
monsters.immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious
monsters.actions:
- *Fearsome Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of the scarecrow's next turn.
- *Terrifying Glare.* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. While Frightened, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

monsters.name: Specter
monsters.resistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monsters.immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
monsters.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak
monsters.traits:
- *Incorporeal Movement.* The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
- *Sunlight Sensitivity.* While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
monsters.actions: - *Life Drain.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

monsters.name: Sphinx of Wonder
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The sphinx has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions: - *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.
monsters.reactions: - *Burst of Ingenuity (2/Day).* Trigger: The sphinx or another creature within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw. Response: The sphinx adds 2 to the roll.

monsters.name: Spy
monsters.skills: Deception +5, Insight +4, Investigation +5, Perception +6, Sleight of Hand +4, Stealth +6
monsters.actions:
- *Shortsword.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
- *Hand Crossbow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Cunning Action.* The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

monsters.name: Swarm of Larvae
monsters.immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
monsters.traits: - *Swarm.* The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through an opening large enough for a Medium creature. The swarm can't regain HP or gain Temporary HP.
monsters.actions: - *Bites.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, or 7 (2d4 + 2) Necrotic damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

monsters.name: Swarm of Piranhas
monsters.immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
monsters.traits:
- *Swarm.* The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny piranha. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
- *Water Breathing.* The swarm can breathe only underwater.
monsters.actions: - *Bites.* Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target doesn't have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage, or 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

monsters.name: Thri-kreen Marauder
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The thri-kreen makes two attacks, using Gythka or Chatkcha in any combination.
- *Gythka.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.
- *Chatkcha.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Leap.* The thri-kreen jumps up to 15 feet by spending 5 feet of movement.

monsters.name: Tiger
monsters.actions: - *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Nimble Escape.* The tiger takes the Disengage or Hide action.

monsters.name: Yuan-ti Infiltrator
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The yuan-ti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The yuan-ti makes two Scimitar attacks.
- *Scimitar.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.
- *Poison Ray.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 120 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Poison damage.
- *Spellcasting.* The yuan-ti casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12): At Will: Animal Friendship (snakes only). 2/Day: Suggestion.

monsters.name: Allosaurus
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The allosaurus makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.
- *Claws.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the allosaurus moved 30+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition, and the allosaurus can make one Bite attack against it.

monsters.name: Animated Rug of Smothering
monsters.immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

monsters.name: Ankheg
monsters.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 11
monsters.actions:
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +5 (Advantage if target is Grappled by the ankheg), reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) Slashing plus 3 (1d6) Acid. Large-or-smaller target: Grappled (escape DC 13).
- *Acid Spray (Recharge 6).* Dex Save DC 12, each creature in a 30-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Acid. Success: half.

monsters.name: Bandit Captain
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two attacks, Scimitar/Pistol any combination.
- *Scimitar.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) Slashing.
- *Pistol.* Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) Piercing.
monsters.reactions: - *Parry.* Trigger: hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: +2 AC against that attack, possibly causing a miss.

monsters.name: Black Dragon Wyrmling
monsters.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 14
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) Slashing plus 2 (1d4) Acid.
- *Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 11, each creature in a 15-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 22 (5d8) Acid. Success: half.

monsters.name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling
monsters.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 14
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) Slashing.
- *Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 12, 40-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 16 (3d10) Lightning. Success: half.
- *Repulsion Breath.* Str Save DC 12, 30-ft Cone. Failure: pushed 30 ft away, Prone.

monsters.name: Bulette Pup
monsters.senses: Darkvision 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 14

monsters.name: Carrion Crawler
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Uses Paralyzing Tentacles and makes one Bite attack.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Poison.
- *Paralyzing Tentacles.* Dex Save DC 12, one creature seen within 10 ft. Failure: Poisoned, repeats save each turn (success ends), auto-success after 1 min; while Poisoned, also Paralyzed.

monsters.name: Centaur Trooper
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two attacks, Pike/Longbow any combination.
- *Pike.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10+4) Piercing.
- *Longbow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) Piercing.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Trampling Charge (Recharge 5–6).* Moves up to Speed without Opportunity Attacks, through Medium-or-smaller creatures' spaces. Str Save DC 14, each creature whose space it enters. Failure: 7 (1d6+4) Bludgeoning, Prone.

monsters.name: Druid
monsters.actions:
- *Club.* Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Produce Flame.* Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30 ft. Hit: 9 (2d8) Fire damage.

- *Spellcasting.* The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks): At will: *Druidcraft, Produce Flame*. 2/Day each: *Entangle, Longstrider*. 1/Day each: *Call Lightning, Spike Growth*.

monsters.name: Ettercap
monsters.traits:
- *Spider Climb.* The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
- *Web Sense.* While in contact with a web, the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
- *Web Walker.* The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The ettercap makes two Bite attacks.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Poison damage.
- *Web Strand (Recharge 5–6).* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the ettercap can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the strand is destroyed (AC 10, HP 5; vulnerability to Fire damage).

monsters.name: Faerie Dragon (Adult)
monsters.traits:
- *Euphoric Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 20-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Euphoric condition for 1 minute.
- *Magic Resistance.* The dragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- *Superior Invisibility (Bonus Action).* As the youth's version, above.
monsters.actions:
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

- *Spellcasting.* The dragon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12): At will: *Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion*. 1/Day each: *Blur, Invisibility* (self only, not the Superior Invisibility trait), *Polymorph* (into a Beast of CR 1 or lower, self only).

monsters.name: Gargoyle
monsters.resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks
monsters.traits:
- *False Appearance.* While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a statue.
- *Flyby.* The gargoyle doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The gargoyle makes two Claw attacks.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

monsters.name: Gelatinous Cube
monsters.immunities: Acid; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone
monsters.senses: Blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), Passive Perception 8
monsters.traits:
- *Ooze Cube.* The cube's space is treated as Difficult Terrain for other creatures. When another creature enters the cube's space, that creature takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage, and the cube can then engulf it.
- *Transparent.* The cube is nearly invisible, and creatures have Disadvantage on Perception checks to spot it (DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) to notice).
monsters.actions: - *Engulf.* The cube enters a Large or smaller creature's space and tries to engulf it. The target makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. Success: The target may choose to be pushed back or to the side of the cube. Failure: The cube enters the target's space, the target takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage and has the Engulfed condition — Restrained, can't breathe (unless it doesn't need to), and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns.

monsters.name: Ghast
monsters.traits:
- *Stench.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the ghast. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.
- *Turning Defiance.* The ghast and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have Advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The ghast makes two Claw attacks.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Giant Boar
monsters.traits: - *Bloodied Fury.* The boar has Advantage on melee attack rolls while it is Bloodied.
monsters.actions: - *Gore.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Giant Constrictor Snake
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The snake makes one Bite attack and uses Constrict.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.
- *Constrict.* Strength Saving Throw: DC 14, one Large or smaller creature the snake can see within 10 feet. Failure: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14).

monsters.name: Giant Elk
monsters.languages: Celestial; understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak them
monsters.actions: - *Ram.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the elk moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Gibbering Mouther
monsters.traits:
- *Aberrant Ground.* The ground in a 10-foot radius centered on the mouther is Difficult Terrain for other creatures.
- *Gibbering.* The mouther babbles incoherently while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther while it is babbling. Failure: The target rolls 1d8 to determine what it does during the current turn:
  - **1–4.** The target does nothing.
  - **5–6.** The target takes no action or Bonus Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction.
  - **7–8.** The target makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The mouther makes one Bite attack and uses Blinding Spittle if available.
- *Bites.* Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (5d6) Piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Prone condition.
- *Blinding Spittle (Recharge 5–6).* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 10-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

monsters.name: Githzerai Monk
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The githzerai makes two Psi Strike attacks.
- *Psi Strike.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Psychic damage.

- *Spellcasting.* The githzerai casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability: At will: *Mage Hand* (the hand is invisible). 1/Day: *See Invisibility*.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Psi-Powered Leap (2/Day).* The githzerai casts *Jump*, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
monsters.reactions: - *Psionic Defense (2/Day).* The githzerai casts *Feather Fall* or *Shield* in response to the spell's trigger, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Gnoll Pack Lord
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The gnoll makes two attacks, using Bone Whip or Bone Javelin in any combination, and it uses Incite Rampage if available.
- *Bone Whip.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing damage.
- *Bone Javelin.* Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
- *Incite Rampage (Recharge 5–6).* The gnoll targets another creature it can see within 60 feet of itself that has the Rampage Bonus Action. The target can take a Reaction to make one melee attack.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Rampage (2/Day).* Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Bone Whip attack.

monsters.name: Green Dragon Wyrmling
monsters.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 14
monsters.traits: - *Amphibious.* The dragon can breathe air and water.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
- *Poison Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 21 (6d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Grick
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The grick makes one Beak attack and one Tentacles attack.
- *Beak.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
- *Tentacles.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12) from all four tentacles.

monsters.name: Griffon
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The griffon makes two Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from both of the griffon's front claws.

monsters.name: Hunter Shark
monsters.traits: - *Water Breathing.* The shark can breathe only underwater.
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +6 (with Advantage if the target doesn't have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Intellect Devourer
monsters.languages: Understands Deep Speech but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft
monsters.traits: - *Detect Intelligence.* The intellect devourer magically senses the location of any creature within 300 feet of itself that has an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The intellect devourer makes one Claw attack and uses Devour Intellect.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.
- *Devour Intellect.* Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the intellect devourer can see within 5 feet. Failure: 11 (2d10) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the intellect devourer's next turn.
- *Steal Body.* Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 12, one Small or Medium creature within 5 feet that has the Incapacitated condition, is a Humanoid or Beast, and has 10 HP or fewer. Failure: The intellect devourer possesses the target, consumes its brain, and teleports inside its skull. While there, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects originating outside its host, retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, its understanding of Deep Speech, its telepathy, and its Detect Intelligence trait, and otherwise adopts the target's game statistics, knowing everything the target knew (including spells and languages). If the host body dies, the intellect devourer must leave it; it's also forced out if the target regains its devoured brain via a *Wish* spell. By spending 5 feet of movement, the intellect devourer can voluntarily leave the body, teleporting to the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of it — the body then dies unless its brain is restored before the end of the intellect devourer's next turn.

monsters.name: Lizardfolk Geomancer
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The lizardfolk makes two Earth Burst attacks.
- *Earth Burst.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Hail of Stone (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point the lizardfolk can see within 60 feet. Failure: 15 (6d4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

- *Spellcasting.* The lizardfolk casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12): At will: *Elementalism*. 1/Day each: *Meld into Stone, Speak with Plants, Spike Growth*.

monsters.name: Mage Apprentice
monsters.actions:
- *Arcane Burst.* Melee or Ranged Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Force damage.

- *Spellcasting.* The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks): At will: *Mage Hand, Prestidigitation*. 1/Day each: *Disguise Self, Ice Knife, Mage Armor* (included in AC), *Thunderwave*.

monsters.name: Merrow
monsters.traits: - *Amphibious.* The merrow can breathe air and water.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the merrow's next turn.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.
- *Harpoon.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself.

monsters.name: Mimic
monsters.traits: - *Adhesive (Object Form Only).* The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.
monsters.actions:
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic), reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage—or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic—plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.
- *Pseudopod.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shape-Shift.* The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monsters.name: Minotaur Skeleton
monsters.actions:
- *Gore.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.
- *Axe.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Modron Pentadrone
monsters.traits: - *Disintegration.* As above.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The modron makes five Slam attacks or five Electrical Discharge attacks.
- *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Force damage.
- *Electrical Discharge.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Lightning damage.
- *Paralysis Gas (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

monsters.name: Myconid Sovereign
monsters.traits: - *Sun Sickness.* As above.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The myconid makes one Slam attack and uses Pacifying Spores.
- *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 1) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.
- *Animating Spores (3/Day).* The myconid releases spores at a Medium or Small corpse within 5 feet of it that wasn't a Construct or an Undead. In 24 hours, the corpse rises as a Myconid Spore Servant. The corpse stays animate for 1d4 + 1 weeks or until destroyed, and it can't be animated again in this way.
- *Pacifying Spores.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the myconid can see within 10 feet. Failure: The target has the Stunned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
- *Rapport Spores.* As the sprout's trait, above.

monsters.name: Nothic
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The nothic makes two Claw attacks.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
- *Rotting Gaze.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the nothic can see within 120 feet. Failure: 17 (5d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Weird Insight (Recharge 6).* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the nothic can see within 120 feet. Failure: The nothic magically learns one fact or secret about the target.

monsters.name: Ochre Jelly
monsters.immunities: Lightning, Slashing; Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained
monsters.traits:
- *Amorphous.* The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
- *Spider Climb.* The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
monsters.actions: - *Pseudopod.* Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.
monsters.reactions: - *Split.* Trigger: While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ HP, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Response: The jelly splits into two new Ochre Jellies. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its Initiative. The original jelly's HP are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).

monsters.name: Ogre
monsters.actions:
- *Greatclub.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Javelin.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Ogre Zombie
monsters.languages: Understands Common and Giant but can't speak
monsters.traits: - *Undead Fortitude.* If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.
monsters.actions: - *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Pegasus
monsters.languages: Understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak
monsters.actions: - *Hooves.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

monsters.name: Peryton
monsters.languages: Understands Common and Elvish but can't speak
monsters.traits: - *Flyby.* The peryton doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The peryton makes one Gore attack and one Talons attack.
- *Gore.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the peryton moved 30+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage.
- *Talons.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage. If the attack reduces a Humanoid target to 0 HP, the peryton kills the target by removing its heart.

monsters.name: Plesiosaurus
monsters.traits: - *Hold Breath.* The plesiosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Polar Bear
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The bear makes two Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

monsters.name: Poltergeist
monsters.resistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monsters.immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
monsters.traits: - *Incorporeal Movement.* The poltergeist can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The poltergeist makes one Object Slam attack and uses Telekinetic Thrust.
- *Object Slam.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Telekinetic Thrust.* Strength Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the poltergeist can see within 30 feet. Failure: 9 (2d6 + 2) Force damage, and the target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the poltergeist.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Vanish.* The poltergeist gives itself the Invisible condition or ends that condition on itself.

monsters.name: Priest
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The priest makes two attacks, using Mace or Radiant Flame in any combination.
- *Mace.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.
- *Radiant Flame.* Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) Radiant damage.
- *Spellcasting.* The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability: At Will: Light, Thaumaturgy. 1/Day: Spirit Guardians.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Divine Aid (3/Day).* The priest casts Bless, Dispel Magic, Healing Word, or Lesser Restoration, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
monsters.ocr_note: Medicine +7 implies Wis mod+2 with expertise/extra +3 beyond prof+2; or Wis score higher than 15. Kept printed skill value; Str/Mace attack (+5) implies Str mod+3 (score ~16) rather than +2 — likely Str 16, not 15; flagged, used 15 for table consistency with "Srn 15" OCR but actual melee math suggests 16.

monsters.name: Quaggoth
monsters.traits: - *Bloodied Fury.* While Bloodied, the quaggoth has Advantage on attack rolls.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The quaggoth makes two Claw attacks.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage, or 13 (3d6 + 3) Slashing damage if the quaggoth is Bloodied.

monsters.name: Rhinoceros
monsters.actions: - *Gore.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage. If target is a Large or smaller creature and the rhinoceros moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
monsters.traits: - *Running Leap.* With a 10-foot running start, the tiger can Long Jump up to 25 feet.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The tiger makes two Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Nimble Escape.* The tiger takes the Disengage or Hide action.

monsters.name: Sahuagin Priest
monsters.traits:
- *Blood Frenzy.* The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.
- *Limited Amphibiousness.* The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.
- *Shark Telepathy.* The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself using a special telepathy.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The sahuagin makes two Spectral Jaws attacks.
- *Spectral Jaws.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Force damage.
- *Spellcasting.* The sahuagin casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12): At Will: Thaumaturgy. 2/Day Each: Hold Person, Tongues.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Fiendish Aid (2/Day).* The sahuagin casts Bless or Healing Word, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Sea Hag
monsters.traits: - *Vile Appearance.* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, any Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this hag's Horrific Appearance for 24 hours.
monsters.actions:
- *Amphibious.* The hag can breathe air and water.
