monsters.name: Medusa
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
- *Snake Hair.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.
- *Poison Ray.* Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the medusa sees its reflection in the Cone, the medusa must make this save. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

monsters.name: Merfolk Wavebender
monsters.traits: - *Amphibious.* The merfolk can breathe air and water.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The merfolk makes two Aquatic Burst attacks.
- *Aquatic Burst.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) Cold damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

- *Spellcasting.* The merfolk casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At will: *Elementalism, Light*. 1/Day each: *Control Water, Create or Destroy Water*.
monsters.reactions: - *Watery Rebuke.* Trigger: An enemy the merfolk can see enters a space within 5 feet of the merfolk. Response—Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, the triggering enemy. Failure: 14 (4d6) Cold damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the merfolk by conjured water.

monsters.name: Performer Maestro
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The performer makes three Rapier attacks.
- *Rapier.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.
- *Beguiling Song.* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet. Failure: 20 (3d10 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the end of the performer's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

- *Spellcasting.* The performer casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At will: *Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation*. 1/Day: *Tasha's Hideous Laughter* (level 3 version).

monsters.name: Pirate Captain
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.
- *Rapier.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the pirate has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.
- *Pistol.* Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Captain's Charm.* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.
monsters.reactions: - *Riposte.* Trigger: The pirate is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The pirate adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the pirate makes one Rapier attack against the triggering creature if within range.

monsters.name: Satyr Revelmaster
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The satyr has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The satyr makes three Prance attacks.
- *Prance.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the satyr's next turn.
- *Fey Melody (Recharge 4–6).* The satyr conjures a charming or frightening song. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, each enemy in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the satyr. Failure: The target is subjected to the song's effect: **Charming** — The target has the Charmed condition for 1 minute. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and uses all its movement to dance in place. The effect ends on the target if it takes any damage. **Frightening** — 10 (2d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. If the target ends its turn out of line of sight from the satyr, the condition ends on it.

monsters.name: Sphinx of Secrets
monsters.traits:
- *Inscrutable.* No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.
- *Magic Resistance.* The sphinx has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The sphinx makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Curse of the Riddle.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.
- *Curse of the Riddle.* Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the sphinx can see within 60 feet. Failure: 21 (6d6) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed with a riddle. The cursed target has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. In addition, if it takes the Magic action, it must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or that action is wasted. The cursed target can take a Study action to make a DC 15 Intelligence check, solving the riddle and ending the curse on a success. The curse ends early if the sphinx curses another target.
- *Spellcasting.* The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At Will: Detect Magic, Identify, Prestidigitation. 1/Day Each: Locate Object, Remove Curse.

monsters.name: Wyvern
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The wyvern makes one Bite attack and one Sting attack.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.
- *Sting.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the wyvern's next turn.

monsters.name: Young Brass Dragon
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 16
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three Rend attacks; may replace two with Sleep Breath.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) Slashing.
- *Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 14, each creature in a 40-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 38 (11d6) Fire. Success: half.
- *Sleep Breath.* Con Save DC 14, each creature in a 30-ft Cone. Failure/Second Failure as Wyrmling, Unconscious 1 min.

monsters.name: Young White Dragon
monsters.speed: 40 ft, Burrow 20 ft, Fly 80 ft, Swim 40 ft
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 16
monsters.traits: - *Ice Walk.* The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The dragon makes three Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.
- *Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 40 (9d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Bandit Deceiver
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three Dagger attacks.
- *Dagger.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4+3) Piercing plus 10 (3d6) Poison.
- *Blinding Flash (Recharge 4–6).* Con Save DC 14, each creature in a 10-ft-radius Sphere centered on a point seen within 120 ft. Failure: 13 (3d6+3) Radiant, Blinded until start of its next turn. Success: half only.
- *Spellcasting.* Intelligence (spell save DC 14). At Will: Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion. 1/Day Each: Hold Person (level 4 version), Mage Armor (included in AC), Major Image.

monsters.name: Blue Slaad
monsters.traits:
- *Magic Resistance.* The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- *Regeneration.* The slaad regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The slaad makes three Mutating Claw attacks.
- *Mutating Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a slaad, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target is cursed. The cursed target can't regain Hit Points, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) after every 24 hours and doesn't return to normal after finishing a Long Rest. If the curse reduces the target's Hit Point maximum to 0, the curse ends, and instead of dying, the target instantly transforms into a Red Slaad or, if it can cast spells of level 3 or higher, a Green Slaad. Only a Wish spell can reverse this transformation.

monsters.name: Centaur Warden
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two attacks, Forest Staff/Sun Ray any combination.
- *Forest Staff.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) Bludgeoning plus 14 (4d6) Poison.
- *Sun Ray.* Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 90 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6+4) Radiant; Blinded until start of centaur's next turn.
- *Spellcasting.* Wisdom (spell save DC 15), no material components. At Will: Druidcraft, Speak with Animals.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Entangling Trail (Recharge 5–6).* Moves up to Speed without Opportunity Attacks. Str Save DC 15, each creature within 5 ft as it moves (once each). Failure: 11 (2d6+4) Bludgeoning, Restrained until end of its next turn.

monsters.name: Giant Ape
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The ape makes two Fist attacks.
- *Fist.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Boulder Toss (Recharge 6).* The ape hurls a boulder at a point it can see within 90 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Failure: 24 (7d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Leap.* The ape jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

monsters.name: Graveyard Revenant
monsters.immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned, Unconscious
monsters.traits: - *Undead Restoration.* If the revenant dies, it revives 24 hours later unless Dispel Evil or Good is cast on its remains. If it revives, it animates another group of corpses elsewhere on the same plane of existence; it now looks different but uses the same stat block and returns with all its Hit Points.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The revenant makes two Suffocate attacks.
- *Suffocate.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is suffocating. The revenant can have up to two targets Grappled in this way at a time.
- *Haunting Glare (Recharge 5–6).* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the revenant. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

monsters.name: Grick Ancient
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The grick makes one Beak attack, one Slam attack, and one Tentacles attack.
- *Beak.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) Piercing damage.
- *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
- *Tentacles.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from all four tentacles.

monsters.name: Mind Flayer
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The mind flayer has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Tentacles.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) Psychic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from all the mind flayer's tentacles, and the target has the Stunned condition until the grapple ends.
- *Extract Brain.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature that is Grappled by the mind flayer's Tentacles. Failure: 55 (10d10) Piercing damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: If this damage reduces the target to 0 HP, the mind flayer kills it and devours its brain.
- *Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6).* Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 31 (6d8 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the mind flayer's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

- *Spellcasting.* The mind flayer casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At will: *Detect Thoughts*. 1/Day each: *Dominate Monster, Plane Shift* (self only).

monsters.name: Oni
monsters.traits: - *Regeneration.* The oni regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 HP.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.
- *Nightmare Ray.* Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni's next turn.

- *Spellcasting.* The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): 1/Day each: *Charm Person* (level 2 version), *Darkness, Gaseous Form, Sleep*.
monsters.bonus_actions:
- *Shape-Shift.* The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
- *Invisibility.* The oni casts *Invisibility* on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Primeval Owlbear
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The owlbear has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The owlbear makes two Ravage attacks.
- *Ravage.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the owlbear moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Slashing damage and has the Prone condition.
- *Screech (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the owlbear. Failure: 27 (6d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

monsters.name: Shield Guardian
monsters.immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsters.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 10
monsters.languages: Understands commands given in any language but can't speak
monsters.traits:
- *Bound.* The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 50 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.
- *Regeneration.* The guardian regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.
- *Spell Storing.* A spellcaster who wears the guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The guardian makes two Fist attacks.
- *Fist.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.
monsters.reactions: - *Protection.* Trigger: An attack roll hits the wearer of the guardian's amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the guardian. Response: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the guardian's next turn.

monsters.name: Stone Giant
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.
- *Stone Club.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Boulder.* Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
monsters.reactions: - *Deflect Missile (Recharge 5–6).* Trigger: The giant is hit by a ranged attack roll and takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from it. Response: The giant reduces the damage it takes from the attack by 11 (1d10 + 6), and if that damage is reduced to 0, the giant can redirect some of the attack's force. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the giant can see within 60 feet. Failure: 11 (1d10 + 6) Force damage.

monsters.name: Tree Blight
monsters.languages: Understands Common and Druidic but can't speak
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Branch attacks and uses Grasping Root.
- *Branch.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6+6) Bludgeoning.
- *Grasping Root.* Str Save DC 17, one Large-or-smaller creature seen within 15 ft. Failure: pulled up to 10 ft toward the blight, Grappled (escape DC 16) from one of six roots; while grappled, 13 (2d6+6) Bludgeoning at start of each turn.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Gnash.* Dex Save DC 17, one creature Grappled by it. Failure: 19 (3d8+5) Piercing. Success: half.

monsters.name: Violet Fungus Necrohulk
monsters.senses: Blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), Passive Perception 6
monsters.traits: - *Absorb Body.* Whenever the necrohulk kills a Medium or smaller creature with a Rotting Touch attack, it can absorb the corpse, healing 10 (3d6) HP.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The necrohulk makes two Rotting Touch attacks and uses Spore Bomb if available.
- *Rotting Touch.* Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Necrotic damage.
- *Spore Bomb (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature within 15 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. Success: Half damage only.

monsters.name: Young Black Dragon
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 16
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4+4) Slashing plus 3 (1d6) Acid.
- *Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 14, each creature in a 30-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 49 (14d6) Acid. Success: half.

monsters.name: Young Copper Dragon
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 17
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three Rend attacks; may replace one with Slowing Breath.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) Slashing.
- *Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 14, 40-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 40 (9d8) Acid. Success: half.
- *Slowing Breath.* Con Save DC 14, 30-ft Cone. (As Wyrmling.)

monsters.name: Yuan-ti Abomination
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The yuan-ti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The yuan-ti makes two Bite attacks, and it can use Spellcasting to cast Suggestion if available.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.
- *Constrict.* Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Large or smaller creature within 5 feet. Failure: 28 (7d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends. Success: Half damage only.
- *Poison Spray (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 21 (6d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the yuan-ti's next turn. While Poisoned, the target has the Blinded condition. Success: Half damage only.
- *Spellcasting (Yuan-ti Form Only).* The yuan-ti casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At Will: Animal Friendship (snakes only). 3/Day: Suggestion.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shape-Shift.* The yuan-ti shape-shifts into a Large snake or returns to its true form. If it dies, it stays in its current form. The yuan-ti's game statistics are the same in each form, except where noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monsters.name: Aberrant Cultist
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Tentacle Lash attacks; may replace any with Mind Rot.
- *Tentacle Lash.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) Slashing plus 14 (4d6) Psychic; Large-or-smaller target Grappled (escape DC 14) from one of two tentacles, Restrained until grapple ends.
- *Mind Rot.* Wis Save DC 15, one creature seen within 90 ft. Failure: 27 (6d8) Psychic, Poisoned until start of cultist's next turn. Success: half only.
- *Spellcasting.* Wisdom (spell save DC 15). At Will: Detect Thoughts, Minor Illusion.
monsters.reactions: - *Counterspell (2/Day).*

monsters.name: Assassin
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three attacks, Shortsword/Light Crossbow any combination.
- *Shortsword.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) Piercing plus 17 (5d6) Poison; target Poisoned until start of assassin's next turn.
- *Light Crossbow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) Piercing plus 21 (6d6) Poison.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Cunning Action.* Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
monsters.ocr_note: Poison dice on the two attacks differ in the OCR — 5d6 vs 6d6 — plausible as written since the ranged version is the higher-damage option; flagging only because OCR confidence on the die count is lower than on the rest of the block.

monsters.name: Berserker Commander
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three attacks, Greataxe/Javelin any combination.
- *Greataxe.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12+4) Slashing, plus 10 (3d6) Thunder to target or another creature within 5 ft of it.
- *Javelin.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6+4) Piercing; target's Speed decreases by 5 ft until start of berserker's next turn.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Frenzied Rush.* Each ally within 30 ft can react to move up to half Speed without Opportunity Attacks; berserker commander can too.

monsters.name: Chain Devil
monsters.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness); Passive Perception 11
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Chain attacks and uses Conjure Infernal Chain.
- *Chain.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) Slashing; Large-or-smaller target Grappled (escape DC 14) from one of two chains, Restrained until grapple ends.
- *Conjure Infernal Chain.* Dex Save DC 15, one creature seen within 60 ft. Failure: 9 (2d4+4) Fire; Restrained until end of devil's next turn (chain then disappears); Large-or-smaller target pulled up to 30 ft toward devil. Success: chain disappears.
monsters.reactions: - *Unnerving Gaze.* Trigger: a creature seen starts its turn within 30 ft and can see the devil. Wis Save DC 15. Failure: Frightened until end of its turn. Success: immune to this devil's Unnerving Gaze for 24 hrs.

monsters.name: Cloaker
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* One Attach attack and two Tail attacks.
- *Attach.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6+3) Piercing. Large-or-smaller target: cloaker attaches — target Blinded, cloaker can't Bite others, halves damage it takes (round down), target takes the same amount. Cloaker detaches for 5 ft movement; target or adjacent creature can DC 14 Str (Athletics) to detach it.
- *Tail.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) Slashing.
monsters.bonus_actions:
- *Phantasms (Recharge after a Short or Long Rest).* Casts Mirror Image (Wis, no components); ends early if cloaker starts/ends turn in Bright Light.
- *Moan.* Wis Save DC 13, each creature in a 60-ft Emanation. Failure: Frightened until end of cloaker's next turn. Success: immune 24 hrs.

monsters.name: Cockatrice Regent
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* One Petrifying Bite and two Talons attacks.
- *Petrifying Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) Piercing. If target is a creature: Con Save DC 14 — First Failure Restrained (repeats, success ends); Second Failure Petrified instead.
- *Talons.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6+4) Slashing.
monsters.reactions: - *Magical Backlash.* Trigger: a creature within 120 ft deals damage to it. Dex Save DC 14. Failure: 13 (3d6+3) Force.

monsters.name: Death Cultist
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three attacks, Dread Scythe/Deathly Ray any combination.
- *Dread Scythe.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10+4) Slashing plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic; target can't regain HP until end of its next turn.
- *Deathly Ray.* Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) Necrotic.
- *Spellcasting.* Wisdom (spell save DC 14). At Will: Speak with Dead, Thaumaturgy.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Spirit Wail (Recharge 5–6).* Wis Save DC 14, each creature in a 20-ft Emanation. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic, Frightened until end of next turn. Success: half only.

monsters.name: Elemental Cultist
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three attacks, Elemental Flail/Elemental Claw any combination.
- *Elemental Flail.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (5d6+4) damage (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder — cultist's choice).
- *Elemental Claw.* Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) damage, same type options; Medium-or-smaller target moved up to 10 ft toward or away from cultist.
- *Spellcasting.* Wisdom (spell save DC 15). At Will: Elementalism, Mage Hand.
monsters.reactions: - *Elemental Absorption (1/Day).* Trigger: takes Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder damage. Response: self Resistance to that instance + 10 Temp HP.

monsters.name: Fiend Cultist
monsters.senses: Darkvision 90 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness); Passive Perception 17
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three Pact Axe attacks.
- *Pact Axe.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12+4) Slashing plus 13 (3d8) Fire.
- *Spellcasting.* Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit). At Will: Scorching Ray (level 5), Thaumaturgy. 2/Day: Fireball (level 6).
monsters.reactions: - *Hellish Rebuke.*

monsters.name: Fomorian
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The fomorian makes two Greatclub attacks.
- *Greatclub.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the fomorian's next turn.
- *Warping Hex (Recharge 5–6).* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the fomorian can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target's Speed is halved, and it has Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, until the end of the fomorian's next turn. Failure by 5 or more: Additionally, the target has the Poisoned condition for the same duration.

monsters.name: Frost Giant
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The giant makes two Greataxe or Frost Giant Spear attacks.
- *Greataxe.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 6) Slashing damage.
- *Frost Giant Spear.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 6) Piercing damage, or 22 (4d6 + 6) Piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the giant used two hands, the target has the Prone condition.
- *War Cry (Recharge 5–6).* Each creature of the giant's choice within 30 feet, excluding the giant, must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or have Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of the giant's next turn.

monsters.name: Githyanki Knight
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The knight makes two Silver Sword attacks.
- *Silver Sword.* Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage if used with two hands.

- *Spellcasting.* The knight can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): At will: *Mage Hand* (invisible), *Jump*, *Misty Step*. 1/Day each: *Plane Shift* (self plus up to 8 willing creatures only), *Telekinesis*.

monsters.name: Gnoll Demoniac
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The gnoll makes two Abyssal Strike attacks.
- *Abyssal Strike.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 50 ft. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) Poison damage.
- *Hunger of Yeenoghu (Recharge 5–6).* The gnoll conjures a 30-foot Cube of magical Darkness originating from a point it can see within 60 feet, which lasts for 1 minute or until the gnoll's Concentration ends on it. This area is Difficult Terrain. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, any creature that starts its turn in this area or enters it for the first time on a turn. Failure: 28 (8d6) Necrotic damage, and the gnoll or a creature of its choice it can see gains 10 Temporary HP. Success: Half damage only.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Rampage (2/Day).* Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Abyssal Strike attack.

monsters.name: Gray Slaad
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 12
monsters.traits:
- *Magic Resistance.* The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- *Regeneration.* The slaad regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The slaad makes three Chaos Staff attacks.
- *Chaos Staff.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Force damage. Until the start of the slaad's next turn, the target has a condition determined by rolling 1d4: on a 1, Charmed; on a 2, Frightened; on a 3, Poisoned; or on a 4, Incapacitated.
- *Spellcasting.* The slaad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand. 1/Day: Fireball, Invisibility (self only).
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shape-Shift.* The slaad shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monsters.name: Hezrou
monsters.traits:
- *Demonic Restoration.* If the hezrou dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its HP somewhere in the Abyss.
- *Magic Resistance.* The hezrou has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- *Stench.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the hezrou. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The hezrou makes three Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Leap.* The hezrou jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

monsters.name: Hydra
monsters.immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, Unconscious
monsters.traits:
- *Hold Breath.* The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.
- *Multiple Heads.* The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more on a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns when it has at least one living head, the hydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken Fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 20 HP when it grows new heads.
- *Reactive Heads.* For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Spirit Naga
monsters.traits: - *Fiendish Restoration.* If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.
- *Necrotic Ray.* Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.
- *Spellcasting.* The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At Will: Detect Magic, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Water Breathing. 2/Day Each: Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Hold Person (level 3), Lightning Bolt (level 4).

monsters.name: Thri-kreen Psion
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The thri-kreen makes three Psionic Lance attacks.
- *Psionic Lance.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Psychic damage.
- *Spellcasting.* The thri-kreen casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At Will: Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible). 1/Day Each: Detect Thoughts, Sending, Synaptic Static.

monsters.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The tyrannosaurus makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and can't be targeted by the tyrannosaurus's Tail.
- *Tail.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 15 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Vampire Nightbringer
monsters.traits: - *Sunlight Hypersensitivity.* The vampire takes 10 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The vampire makes one Bite attack and one Shadow Strike attack.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.
- *Shadow Strike.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Cold damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shadow Stealth.* While in Dim Light or Darkness, the vampire takes the Hide action.

monsters.name: Young Bronze Dragon
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 17
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three Rend attacks; may replace one with Repulsion Breath.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) Slashing.
- *Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 15, 60-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 49 (9d10) Lightning. Success: half.
- *Repulsion Breath.* Str Save DC 15, 30-ft Cone. Failure: pushed 40 ft away, Prone.

monsters.name: Young Green Dragon
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 17
monsters.traits: - *Amphibious.* The dragon can breathe air and water.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The dragon makes three Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
- *Poison Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 42 (12d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Abominable Yeti
monsters.traits: - *Fear of Fire.* If the yeti takes Fire damage, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The yeti can use its Chilling Gaze and makes two attacks, using Claw or Ice Throw in any combination.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.
- *Ice Throw.* Ranged Attack Roll: +11, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 12 (2d4 + 7) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.
- *Chilling Gaze.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature the yeti can see within 30 feet. Failure: 21 (6d6) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of the yeti's next turn unless the target has Immunity to Cold damage. Success: The target is immune to this yeti's Chilling Gaze for 1 hour.
- *Cold Breath (Recharge 6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 45 (10d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Bone Devil
monsters.skills: Deception +7, Insight +5 🚨 *(mod+2, if proficient +2+4=+6, not +5 — minor mismatch, flagged)*
monsters.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness); Passive Perception 12
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Claw attacks and one Infernal Sting attack.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) Slashing.
- *Infernal Sting.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10+4) Piercing plus 18 (4d8) Poison; Poisoned until start of devil's next turn (can't regain HP while Poisoned).

monsters.name: Brazen Gorgon
monsters.traits:
- *Flame Aura.* At the end of each of the gorgon's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the gorgon takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage.
- *Illumination.* The gorgon sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The gorgon makes two Gore attacks.
- *Gore.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
- *Smelting Charge (Recharge 5–6).* The gorgon moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each time the gorgon enters a creature's space for the first time during this move, that target is subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Fire damage, and the target is pulled into the gorgon's space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14); if the gorgon already has a creature Grappled, the target has the Prone condition instead. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition. When the gorgon moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing no extra movement.

monsters.name: Clay Golem
monsters.immunities: Acid, Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsters.traits:
- *Acid Absorption.* Takes no Acid damage; instead regains HP equal to the Acid damage.
- *Berserk.* Whenever it starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6; on a 6, goes berserk — attacks nearest creature (or an object if none in reach) each turn until destroyed or no longer Bloodied.
- *Immutable Form.*
- *Magic Resistance.*
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Slam attacks (three if it used Hasten this turn).
- *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10+5) Bludgeoning plus 6 (1d12) Acid; target's HP max decreases by the Acid damage taken.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Hasten (Recharge 5–6).* Takes the Dash and Disengage actions.

monsters.name: Cloud Giant
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two attacks, Thunderous Mace/Thundercloud any combination; may replace one with Spellcasting (Fog Cloud).
- *Thunderous Mace.* Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8+8) Bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) Thunder.
- *Thundercloud.* Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 240 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6+8) Thunder; Incapacitated until end of its next turn.
- *Spellcasting.* Charisma (spell save DC 15), no material components. At Will: Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light. 1/Day Each: Control Weather, Gaseous Form, Telekinesis.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Misty Step.*

monsters.name: Fire Giant
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The giant makes two Greatsword or Fire Giant Spear attacks.
- *Greatsword.* Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) Slashing damage.
- *Fire Giant Spear.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 7) Piercing damage, or 25 (4d8 + 7) Piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
- *War Cry (Recharge 5–6).* Each creature of the giant's choice within 30 feet, excluding the giant, must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or gain a +4 bonus to attack rolls (if ally, and giant's choice) for 1 minute; or, if used as an intimidation, enemies have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the giant until the start of its next turn.

monsters.name: Glabrezu
monsters.traits:
- *Demonic Restoration.* If the glabrezu dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its HP somewhere in the Abyss.
- *Magic Resistance.* The glabrezu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The glabrezu makes two Pincer attacks and uses Pummel or Spellcasting.
- *Pincer.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of two pincers.
- *Pummel.* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature Grappled by the glabrezu. Failure: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

- *Spellcasting.* The glabrezu casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At will: *Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic*. 1/Day each: *Confusion, Fly, Power Word Stun*.

monsters.name: Green Slaad
monsters.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 17
monsters.traits:
- *Magic Resistance.* The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- *Regeneration.* The slaad regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The slaad makes two Chaos Claw attacks.
- *Chaos Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. Until the start of the slaad's next turn, the target has a condition determined by rolling 1d4: on a 1, Charmed; on a 2, Frightened; on a 3, Poisoned; or on a 4, Incapacitated.
- *Spellcasting.* The slaad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At Will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Major Image. 1/Day Each: Cloudkill, Fly, Plane Shift (self only), Tongues.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shape-Shift.* The slaad shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monsters.name: Nycaloth
monsters.traits:
- *Fiendish Restoration.* If the nycaloth dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its HP somewhere in Gehenna.
- *Magic Resistance.* The nycaloth has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The nycaloth makes two Mercurial Axe attacks.
- *Mercurial Axe.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. or range 30/90 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Force damage. Hit or Miss: The axe magically returns to the nycaloth's hand immediately after a ranged attack.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shadowy Teleport.* The nycaloth has the Invisible condition for 1 minute, and it teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The condition ends early immediately after it deals damage.
monsters.ocr_note: OCR printed HP as "152 (15d10 + 64)"; 15d10 averages 82.5+64=146.5, while 16d10+64=152 reconciles exactly — recorded 16d10 as the likely correct die count.

monsters.name: Treant
monsters.traits: - *Siege Monster.* The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The treant makes two Slam attacks.
- *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Hail of Bark.* Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 180 ft. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) Piercing damage.
- *Animate Trees (1/Day).* The treant magically animates up to two trees it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each tree uses the Treant stat block, except it has Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, it can't speak, and it lacks this action. The tree takes its turn immediately after the treant on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the treant. A tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, the treant dies, or it is more than 120 feet from the treant. The tree then takes root if possible.

monsters.name: Young Blue Dragon
monsters.skills: Perception +9 🚨 *(mod+1, prof+3 → +4, but OCR shows a higher value — 2024 young dragons are usually proficient in Perception at double-ish bonus from expertise-like design; keeping the source's +9 but flagging), Stealth +4*
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 19
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) Slashing plus 5 (1d10) Lightning.
- *Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 15, each creature in a 60-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 55 (10d10) Lightning. Success: half.

monsters.name: Young Silver Dragon
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 18
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Paralyzing Breath.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage.
- *Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 49 (11d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
- *Paralyzing Breath.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
monsters.ocr_note: HP printed "168 (16d10 + 80)" reconstructed from Con mod +5 ×16=80; original OCR line was heavily garbled ("ne rss") — kept the math-consistent total.

monsters.name: Aboleth
monsters.traits:
- *Amphibious.* Breathes air and water.
- *Eldritch Restoration.* If destroyed, gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all HP in the Far Realm or elsewhere (DM's choice).
- *Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair).*
- *Mucus Cloud.* While underwater, surrounded by mucus. Con Save DC 14, each creature in a 5-ft Emanation at end of the aboleth's turn. Failure: cursed — skin becomes slimy, can breathe air/water, can't regain HP unless underwater; while outside water, takes 6 (1d12) Acid every 10 min unless moistened first.
- *Probing Telepathy.* Learns the greatest desires of any creature it sees that communicates telepathically with it.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Tentacle attacks, and uses Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.
- *Tentacle.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) Bludgeoning. Large or smaller target: Grappled (escape DC 14) from one of four tentacles.
- *Consume Memories.* Int Save DC 15, one creature within 30 ft Charmed/Grappled by the aboleth. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic. Success: half. Either: if target is a Humanoid reduced to 0 HP by this action, aboleth gains its memories.
- *Dominate Mind (2/Day).* Wis Save DC 15, one creature seen within 30 ft. Failure: Charmed until aboleth dies or changes plane; while Charmed acts as ally within 500 ft and the two can communicate telepathically at any distance. Target repeats save on taking damage and every 24 hrs spent 1+ mile away.

monsters.name: Cultist Hierophant
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three attacks, Pact Blade/Radiant Ray any combination.
- *Pact Blade.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) Slashing plus 18 (4d8) Radiant.
- *Radiant Ray.* Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12+5) Radiant.
- *Spellcasting.* Charisma (spell save DC 17). At Will: Mage Armor (included in AC), Thaumaturgy. 1/Day Each: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance (level 7), Mass Suggestion.

monsters.name: Cyclops Oracle
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three attacks, Radiant Strike/Flash of Light any combination.
- *Radiant Strike.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10+5) Radiant.
- *Flash of Light.* Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10+6) Radiant; Disadvantage on attacks until end of cyclops's next turn.
- *Spellcasting.* Wisdom (spell save DC 15), no material components. 2/Day Each: Arcane Eye, Detect Magic, Locate Object. 1/Day: Legend Lore.
monsters.reactions: - *Portent (Recharge 4–6).* Trigger: cyclops or a seen ally makes a d20 Test. Response: rolls 1d20, may substitute it for the die rolled.

monsters.name: Death Slaad
monsters.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 18
monsters.traits:
- *Magic Resistance.* The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- *Regeneration.* The slaad regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The slaad makes two Chaos Blade attacks.
- *Chaos Blade.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Until the start of the slaad's next turn, the target has a condition determined by rolling 1d4: on a 1, Charmed; on a 2, Frightened; on a 3, Poisoned; or on a 4, Incapacitated.
- *Spellcasting.* The slaad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At Will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Major Image. 1/Day Each: Blight (level 5 version), Cloudkill (level 6 version), Fly, Plane Shift, Tongues.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shape-Shift.* The slaad shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monsters.name: Deva
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Two Holy Mace attacks.
- *Holy Mace.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) Bludgeoning plus 18 (4d8) Radiant.
- *Spellcasting.* Charisma (spell save DC 17), no material components. At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Shapechange (Beast/Humanoid only, no temp HP, no Concentration needed). 1/Day Each: Commune, Raise Dead.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Divine Aid (2/Day).* Casts Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse.

monsters.name: Dire Worg
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The worg has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The worg makes three Bite attacks.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the worg's next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points.
- *Dreadful Howl (Recharge 5–6).* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature within 30 feet that isn't a worg. Failure: 35 (8d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the worg's next turn. Success: Half damage only.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Worg Step.* The worg teleports, along with a willing creature of its choice within 5 feet of it, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monsters.name: Guardian Naga
monsters.traits: - *Celestial Restoration.* If the naga dies, it returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its HP unless *Dispel Evil and Good* is cast on its remains.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The naga makes two Bite attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Poisonous Spittle.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) Poison damage.
- *Poisonous Spittle.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the naga can see within 60 feet. Failure: 31 (7d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the naga's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

- *Spellcasting.* The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At will: *Thaumaturgy*. 1/Day each: *Clairvoyance, Cure Wounds* (level 6 version), *Flame Strike* (level 6 version), *Geas, True Seeing*.

monsters.name: Haunting Revenant
monsters.immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
monsters.traits:
- *Haunted Zone.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, any creature that casts a spell while inside the revenant's space. Failure: The spell fails and is wasted.
- *Undead Restoration.* If the revenant dies, it revives 24 hours later unless Dispel Evil or Good is cast on its remains. If it revives, it animates another Gargantuan object or structure elsewhere on the same plane of existence; it now looks different but uses the same stat block and returns with all its Hit Points.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The revenant makes two Object Slam attacks and uses Invitation.
- *Object Slam.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9 (with Advantage if the target is inside the revenant's space), reach 10 ft. or range 30/90 ft. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.
- *Invitation.* Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: The target is teleported inside the revenant's space and swallowed. A swallowed creature has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the revenant. While the revenant has Hit Points, a swallowed creature can leave the revenant's space only by using magic that enables planar travel, such as the Plane Shift spell.
monsters.ocr_note: Three Revenant variants were interleaved in the OCR (base Revenant, Graveyard, Haunting); ability blocks were matched to each by size category and resulting save math — Graveyard's printed "+8" saves for Str/Con/Cha fit PB+3 proficient; Haunting's "+9/+8/+7" fit PB+4 proficient at those abilities.

monsters.name: Noble Prodigy
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The noble makes three Beguiling Strike attacks.
- *Beguiling Strike.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the noble's next turn.

- *Spellcasting.* The noble casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At will: *Mage Armor* (included in AC), *Mage Hand, Minor Illusion*. 1/Day each: *Befuddlement, Detect Thoughts, Fly, Scrying, Shatter* (level 7 version).
monsters.reactions: - *Shield (2/Day).* The noble casts *Shield* in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Performer Legend
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The performer makes three Bejeweled Baton attacks.
- *Bejeweled Baton.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.
- *Majestic Song.* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet. Failure: 22 (4d8 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed or Frightened condition (performer's choice) until the end of the performer's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

- *Spellcasting.* The performer casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): At will: *Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation*. 1/Day each: *Major Image, Project Image*.
monsters.reactions: - *Wording Charm.* Trigger: A creature hits the performer with an attack roll. Response—Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, the triggering creature. Failure: The attack roll misses the performer, and the target has the Charmed condition until the end of the performer's next turn.

monsters.name: Spy Master
monsters.skills: Deception +7, Insight +7, Investigation +8, Perception +11, Sleight of Hand +9, Stealth +13
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The spy makes three attacks, using Rapier or Hand Crossbow in any combination.
- *Rapier.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
- *Hand Crossbow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.
- *Smoke Bomb (1/Day).* The spy throws a bomb to a point it can see within 30 feet of itself. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Failure: 28 (8d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of the spy's next turn. Success: Half damage only.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Cunning Action.* The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

monsters.name: Stone Golem
monsters.immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsters.languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak
monsters.traits:
- *Immutable Form.* The golem can't shape-shift.
- *Magic Resistance.* The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.
- *Slam.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.
- *Force Bolt.* Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) Force damage.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Slow (Recharge 5–6).* The golem casts the Slow spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

monsters.name: Warrior Commander
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The warrior makes three attacks, using Greatsword or Longbow in any combination.
- *Greatsword.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) Slashing damage. The warrior also creates one of the following effects: **Sap** — The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the warrior's next turn. **Maneuver** — One ally who can see or hear the warrior can take a Reaction to move up to half the ally's Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- *Longbow.* Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the target's next turn.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Tactical Charge.* The warrior moves up to half its Speed straight toward an enemy it can see without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
monsters.reactions: - *Counterattack.* Trigger: The warrior is hit by an attack roll. Response: The warrior adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the warrior can make one Greatsword or Longbow attack against the attacker.

monsters.name: Yochlol
monsters.traits:
- *Demonic Restoration.* If the yochlol dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points in the Abyss.
- *Magic Resistance.* The yochlol has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- *Spider Climb.* The yochlol can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
- *Web Walker.* The yochlol ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The yochlol makes two Caustic Lash attacks, and it can use Spellcasting to cast Web or Dominate Person if available.
- *Caustic Lash.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) Acid damage.
- *Spellcasting.* The yochlol casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At Will: Detect Thoughts, Gaseous Form (self only), Web. 1/Day: Dominate Person.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Shape-Shift.* The yochlol shape-shifts into a Medium Humanoid or a Medium spider or back into its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
monsters.reactions: - *Toxic Escape.* Trigger: The yochlol is hit by an attack roll. Response: The yochlol halves the attack's damage to itself (round down), and it teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within 5 feet of the yochlol's destination space. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, it has the Incapacitated condition.

monsters.name: Young Gold Dragon
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 19
monsters.traits: - *Amphibious.* The dragon can breathe air and water.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Weakening Breath.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Slashing damage.
- *Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 55 (10d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
- *Weakening Breath.* Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature that isn't currently affected by this breath in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 3 (1d6) from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

monsters.name: Young Red Dragon
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 18
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The dragon makes three Rend attacks.
- *Rend.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
- *Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 56 (16d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Bandit Crime Lord
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three attacks, Scimitar/Pistol any combination.
- *Scimitar.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) Slashing plus 14 (4d6) Poison.
- *Pistol.* Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10+5) Piercing plus 14 (4d6) Poison.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Deadly Aim.* Gives itself Advantage on its next attack roll this turn; on a hit, extra 28 (8d6) Poison.

monsters.name: Behir
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* One Bite attack and uses Constrict.
- *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12+6) Piercing plus 11 (2d10) Lightning.
- *Constrict.* Str Save DC 18, one Large or smaller creature seen within 5 ft. Failure: 28 (5d8+6) Bludgeoning; Grappled (escape DC 16) and Restrained until grapple ends.
- *Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 15, each creature in a 90-ft-long 5-ft-wide Line. Failure: 66 (12d10) Lightning. Success: half.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Swallow.* Dex Save DC 18, one Large-or-smaller creature Grappled by the behir (only one swallowed at a time). Failure: swallowed (no longer Grappled); Blinded+Restrained, Total Cover vs outside effects, takes 21 (6d6) Acid at start of each of behir's turns. If behir takes 30+ damage in one turn from the swallowed creature, it must succeed DC 14 Con save at end of that turn or regurgitate it (falls within 10 ft, Prone). On behir's death, swallowed creature escapes with 15 ft of movement, Prone.

monsters.name: Dao
monsters.traits:
- *Earth Glide.*
- *Elemental Restoration.* Dies outside the Plane of Earth: new body in 1d4 days, revives there with all HP.
- *Magic Resistance.*
- *Wishes.* 30% chance of knowing Wish; can cast it only on behalf of a communicating non-genie, suffering none of the stress; 3 uses then locked out 365 days.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three Earthen Maul attacks or two Earth Burst attacks.
- *Earthen Maul.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6+6) Bludgeoning; Large-or-smaller target Prone.
- *Earth Burst.* Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8+5) Bludgeoning. Hit or Miss: Dex Save DC 15, each creature in a 10-ft Emanation from target's space. Failure: 10 (3d6) Thunder.
- *Spellcasting.* Charisma (spell save DC 16), no material components. At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Stone Shape. 1/Day Each: Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Move Earth, Passwall, Plane Shift, Tongues, Wall of Stone.

monsters.name: Death Knight Aspirant
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three Dread Blade attacks.
- *Dread Blade.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8+5) Slashing plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic.
- *Hellfire Orb (Recharge 5–6).* Dex Save DC 15, 20-ft-radius Sphere within 120 ft. Failure: 21 (6d6) Fire plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic. Success: half.
- *Spellcasting.* Charisma (spell save DC 15). At Will: Phantom Steed. 1/Day: Destructive Wave (Necrotic), Dispel Magic.
monsters.reactions: - *Parry.* +4 AC against a melee attack.

monsters.name: Djinni
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three attacks, Storm Blade/Storm Bolt any combination.
- *Storm Blade.* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) Slashing plus 7 (2d6) Lightning.
- *Storm Bolt.* Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d8) Thunder; Large-or-smaller target Prone.
- *Create Whirlwind.* Conjures a 20-ft-radius, 60-ft-high Cylinder whirlwind within 120 ft, lasting while Concentrating; movable 20 ft/turn. Str Save DC 17 (once/turn per creature; djinni unaffected) on entering. Failure: Restrained, moves with whirlwind, 21 (6d6) Thunder at start of each turn; repeats save at end of each turn (success ends).
- *Spellcasting.* Charisma (spell save DC 17), no material components. At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic. 2/Day Each: Create Food and Water (wine option), Tongues, Wind Walk. 1/Day Each: Creation, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift.

monsters.name: Efreeti
monsters.traits:
- *Elemental Restoration.* If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body disintegrates into ash, and it returns to the Elemental Plane of Fire instantly, reviving with all its HP after 1d4 days.
- *Magic Resistance.* The efreeti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
- *Wishes.* An efreeti forced to serve a creature through means such as a *Wish* spell or being trapped in a bottle does so with extreme reluctance and executes the letter of any instructions while subverting their intent.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The efreeti makes two Scimitar attacks or uses Hurl Flame twice.
- *Scimitar.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.
- *Hurl Flame.* Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 24 (7d6) Fire damage.

- *Spellcasting.* The efreeti can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At will: *Detect Magic*. 1/Day each: *Enlarge/Reduce, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift (self only), Wall of Fire*.

monsters.name: Horned Devil
monsters.senses: Darkvision 150 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness), Passive Perception 13
monsters.traits:
- *Diabolical Restoration.* If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its HP somewhere in the Nine Hells.
- *Magic Resistance.* The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The devil makes three attacks, using Searing Fork or Hurl Flame in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Infernal Tail.
- *Searing Fork.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Fire damage.
- *Hurl Flame.* Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 150 ft. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.
- *Infernal Tail.* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the devil can see within 10 feet. Failure: 10 (1d8 + 5) Necrotic damage, and the target receives an infernal wound if it doesn't have one. While wounded, the target loses 10 (3d6) HP at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores HP to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

monsters.name: Marid
monsters.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 13
monsters.traits:
- *Amphibious.* The marid can breathe air and water.
- *Elemental Restoration.* If the marid dies outside the Elemental Plane of Water, its body dissolves into brine, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its HP somewhere on the Plane of Water.
- *Wishes.* The marid has a 30 percent chance of knowing the *Wish* spell. If the marid knows it, the marid can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the marid can understand. If the marid casts the spell for the creature, the marid suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the marid has cast it three times, the marid can't do so again for 365 days.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The marid makes three Aquatic Lash attacks.
- *Aquatic Lash.* Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 15 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.
- *Water Jet.* Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line. Failure: 31 (9d6) Cold damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the marid and has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

- *Spellcasting.* The marid casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At will: *Create or Destroy Water, Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Purify Food and Drink*. 1/Day each: *Control Water, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Plane Shift, Tongues*.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Misty Veil (Recharge 5–6).* The marid casts *Fog Cloud*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Mind Flayer Arcanist
monsters.traits: - *Magic Resistance.* The mind flayer has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The mind flayer makes three Arcane Tentacles attacks.
- *Arcane Tentacles.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) Psychic damage, and the mind flayer can teleport the target up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the mind flayer can see on a surface or liquid large enough to support the target. If this damage reduces the target to 0 HP, the mind flayer kills it and magically devours its brain.
- *Mind Burst (Recharge 5–6).* Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 40-foot Emanation originating from the mind flayer. Failure: 41 (8d8 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the mind flayer's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

- *Spellcasting.* The mind flayer casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): At will: *Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Mage Hand* (the hand is invisible). 1/Day each: *Clairvoyance, Dimension Door, Fireball* (level 5 version), *Lightning Bolt* (level 5 version), *Plane Shift* (self only), *Sending*.
monsters.reactions: - *Shield (2/Day).* The mind flayer casts *Shield* in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Remorhaz
monsters.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 10
monsters.traits: - *Heat Aura.* At the end of each of the remorhaz's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the remorhaz takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.
monsters.actions: - *Bite.* Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Swallow.* Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the remorhaz (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed by the remorhaz, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns. If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the remorhaz and has the Prone condition. If the remorhaz dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

monsters.name: Roc
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The roc makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one attack with a Talons attack.
- *Beak.* Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 28 (3d12 + 9) Piercing damage.
- *Talons.* Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) from both talons, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Swoop (Recharge 5–6).* If the roc has a creature Grappled, the roc flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and drops that creature.

monsters.name: Sphinx of Lore
monsters.traits:
- *Inscrutable.* No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.
- *Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair).* If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* The sphinx makes three Claw attacks.
- *Claw.* Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
- *Mind-Rending Roar (Recharge 5–6).* Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each enemy in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the sphinx's next turn.
- *Spellcasting.* The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At Will: Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation. 1/Day Each: Dispel Magic, Legend Lore, Locate Object, Plane Shift, Remove Curse, Tongues.
monsters.legendary_actions:
Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the sphinx can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The sphinx regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.
- *Arcane Prowl.* The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.
- *Weight of Years.* Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

**Lair:** within 1 mile — *Distant Sight* (the sphinx can cast Clairvoyance, range 1 mile, while in its lair) · *Infusion of Knowledge* (the sphinx or an ally taking a Study action adds 1d6 to the check). Effects end immediately if the sphinx dies or moves its lair.

monsters.name: Arcanaloth
monsters.traits:
- *Fiendish Restoration.* If it dies outside Gehenna, dissolves into ichor and gains a new body instantly in Gehenna.
- *Magic Resistance.* Advantage on saves vs. spells/magical effects.
- *Soul Tome.* Has a magic tome; while holding/carrying it can use Banishing Claw. Tome: AC 17, HP 35, Immunity to Necrotic/Poison/Psychic; regains all HP at end of every turn, but turns to dust if reduced to 0 HP or the arcanaloth dies. Destroyed tome → arcanaloth can make a new one after a Short/Long Rest.
monsters.actions:
- *Multiattack.* Three Fiendish Burst attacks; may replace one with Banishing Claw.
- *Fiendish Burst.* Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12+5) Necrotic.
- *Banishing Claw (Requires Soul Tome).* Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4+5) Slashing plus 19 (3d12) Psychic. If target is a creature: Cha Save DC 17. Failure: trapped in a demiplane inside the tome, Incapacitated; repeats save at end of each turn, escapes on success (appears in space it left or nearest open space). Failing three saves while trapped binds it to the tome until the tome is reduced to 0 HP.
- *Spellcasting.* Intelligence (spell save DC 17), no material components. At Will: Alter Self, Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation. 1/Day Each: Contact Other Plane, Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Mind Blank.
monsters.bonus_actions: - *Teleport.* Up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space it can see.
monsters.reactions: - *Counterspell.* Casts Counterspell in response to that spell's trigger, using Spellcasting's ability.

monsters.name: Archmage
